title: Reusable UI Component Library
objective: Build a documented library of consistent components that can be reused across pages or projects.

milestones.title: Button variants, cards, inputs, badges and alerts
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate button variants, cards, inputs, badges and alerts in the project.
Keep the implementation responsive, semantic and maintainable.

milestones.title: Theme variables and component states
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate theme variables and component states in the project.
Keep the implementation responsive, semantic and maintainable.

milestones.title: Keyboard focus support
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate keyboard focus support in the project.
Keep the implementation responsive, semantic and maintainable.

milestones.title: Component usage and customization documentation
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate component usage and customization documentation in the project.
Keep the implementation responsive, semantic and maintainable.

required_features: Button variants, cards, inputs, badges and alerts
stretch_features: Add a documented theme variant or design token where appropriate.
Add a visual regression check for one representative state.
Document a trade-off or browser-support limitation.
tests: Build with the configured Vite/Tailwind workflow.
Inspect narrow, medium and wide viewport layouts.
Check keyboard navigation, focus indication, semantic roles and contrast.
Verify that required utility classes appear in generated CSS.
review_method: Static source checks plus human review; project code is not executed in the production FastAPI process.
status_note: Draft project outline; verify the implementation against the resolved dependencies before publication.
